title: The Country Lock and the War on Xuan Wu
summary: The fire beasts of Huo Fen mutate and grow stronger, and the cultivators of the Huo Chu Alliance break out toward the border with Xuan Wu Country. Li Muwan's elder brother Li Qiqing burns out his consciousness holding back the beasts so that she can escape. The four great sects seal the fire beasts' birthplace, and several Nascent Soul cultivators leave their Nascent Souls inside the Country-Locking Formation to keep the beasts shut inside Huo Fen. Once across the border the alliance storms the Qingxin Sect and announces rewards for kills, counted by a jade talisman, while Luo He Sect offers a Tianli Pill each month to whoever kills the most. Feng Luan gives Wang Lin the first part of Lin Tao's map and promises the rest if he kills 50 Foundation Establishment cultivators, and 150 enemies by the end of the war. Posted with the eighth team to block reinforcements, Wang Lin kills seven Foundation Establishment cultivators in an instant, then fights a late Foundation Establishment cultivator and a Core Formation cultivator who finds him using Earth Escape.

changes: Written from the official English YouTube subtitles (machine-translated) checked against the AnimeKhor Indonesian fansubs; no Chinese track for this episode.
'Junior Sister Mu'er/Mu Wan' and 'Wan'er' = Li Muwan; 'Brother Qiqing' = her elder brother Li Qiqing (the wiki says he dies here in the donghua).
'Fire Burning Alliance / Burning Alliance' = the Huo Chu Alliance (火楚盟, from the EP26 Chinese track); 'Suoguo Formation' = Country-Locking Formation (锁国大阵); 'Luohemen' = Luo He Sect.
